blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: This paper presents the design and implementation of Auriga Robotics' mobile manipulator robot, developed at the Robotics and Intelligent Automation Laboratory, Department of Electrical Engineering, Shahid Beheshti University. Hereafter, this platform is referred to as the @Work Robot. The robot targets industrial tasks, with an emphasis on improving efficiency in repetitive or hazardous work environments. It uses a 4-wheel Mecanum drive for omnidirectional movement and a 5-degree-of-freedom manipulator arm with a 3D-printed gripper for object handling and navigation. The electronics consist of custom PCB boards built around ESP32 microcontrollers, together with an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX that handles high-level processing and real-time system control. On the software side, Hector SLAM provides mapping and localization, A* handles path planning, and YOLO performs real-time object detection. These modules draw on fused sensor data to deliver robust navigation and reliable collision avoidance. Overall, the system shows effective hardware-software integration, with consistent performance in autonomous navigation, object handling, and task execution in industrial-like settings.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了由Shahid Beheshti大学电气工程系机器人和智能自动化实验室开发的Auriga Robotics移动操纵机器人的设计与实施。 后世,这个平台被称为"@Work Robot". 该机器人以工业任务为目标,重点是提高重复或危险工作环境中的效率。 它使用4轮Mecanum驱动器进行全向运动,并使用5度自由操纵臂并配有3D打印的抓取器来进行物体处理和导航. 电子由围绕ESP32微控制器所建造的定制PCB板组成,并配有能处理高水平处理和实时系统控制的NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. 在软件方面,Hector SLAM提供映射和本地化,A*处理路径规划,而YOLO则进行实时对象检测. 这些模块利用已安装引信的传感器数据,以提供强有力的导航和可靠的避免相撞。 总的来说,系统显示有效的硬件-软件集成,在类似工业环境下,在自主导航,对象处理和任务执行中具有一致的性能.

blocks.en: 1.  Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Robotics has become a core part of modern industrial settings, offering practical ways to optimize tasks and boost productivity. Within this context, @Work Robots work alongside human operators, helping create safer and more efficient workspaces. These robots can be deployed for a range of tasks, including production line support, transport in constrained spaces, object handling, and jobs that are difficult or unpleasant for humans to perform. This growing range of applications reflects the increasing importance of autonomous mobile manipulation in the future of industrial automation.
blocks.zh: 机器人已成为现代工业环境的核心部分,为优化任务和提高生产率提供了切实可行的途径. 在此背景下,@Work Robots与人类操作人员一起工作,帮助创建更安全和更有效的工作空间. 这些机器人可以用于一系列任务,包括生产线支持,在受限空间的运输,物品处理,以及人类难以完成或不愉快的工作. 这种不断扩大的应用范围反映了自主移动操纵在工业自动化未来日益重要.

blocks.en: The goal of this project is to build a modular, highly adaptable platform that addresses these operational challenges — a versatile testbed that bridges academic research in mobile manipulation with practical, scalable industrial deployment.
blocks.zh: 该项目的目标是建立一个模块化、适应性强的平台,以应对这些业务挑战——一个多功能的试验台,将移动操纵方面的学术研究与实际的、可扩展的工业部署联系起来。

blocks.zh: 图1:奥里加的@工作机器人.

blocks.en: Auriga Robotics at Shahid Beheshti University developed an autonomous mobile manipulation platform for the RoboCup @Work league, shown in Figure 1 . The robot is built to handle perception, navigation, manipulation, and real-time decision-making. The project is part of the team’s ongoing research in intelligent robotics and autonomous systems, aimed at producing a modular, extensible platform for academic research and experimental work in industrial automation. Among the main contributions of this work are custom electronics for optimized power and sensor integration, and a vision-based dynamic obstacle mapping framework that improves navigation in complex environments.
blocks.zh: Shahid Beheshti大学的Auriga机器人公司为RoboCup@Work League开发了一个自主的移动操纵平台,如图1所示。 机器人是用来处理感知,导航,操纵,以及实时决策的. 该项目是团队正在进行的智能机器人和自主系统研究的一部分,旨在为工业自动化领域的学术研究和实验工作提供一个模块化,可扩展的平台. 这项工作的主要贡献包括优化功率和传感器集成的定制电子产品,以及基于视觉的动态障碍绘图框架,改善复杂环境下的导航.

blocks.en: This paper covers the design process and system integration of the Auriga Robotics @Work platform, with emphasis on its modular hardware and intelligent control architecture. It is organized as follows: Section 2 presents the hardware design, including the mechanical structure, electronics, and sensors. Section 3 describes the embedded firmware architecture — sensor integration and communication between the onboard processing units — and details the software infrastructure and ROS-based communication architecture. Section 4 discusses perception and computer vision algorithms. Section 5 covers robot control, navigation, and decision-making.
blocks.zh: 本文涵盖了Auriga Robotics@Work平台的设计过程和系统集成,强调其模块化硬件和智能控制架构. 第2节介绍硬件设计,包括机械结构、电子和传感器。 第3节描述了嵌入式固件架构——传感器集成和机载处理单元之间的通信,并详细介绍了软件基础设施和基于ROS的通信架构. 第四节讨论感知和计算机视觉算法. 第5节涵盖机器人控制、导航和决策。

blocks.en: 2.  Hardware Description
blocks.zh: 2. 硬件说明

blocks.en: 2.1  Mechanical Design
blocks.zh: 2.1 机械设计

blocks.en: 2.1.1  Base Structure Design
blocks.zh: 2.1.1 基础结构设计

blocks.en: The chassis and base structure are built mainly from aluminum profiles, giving a frame that is both lightweight and sturdy. The base measures 65 cm in length, 42 cm in width, and 56 cm in height, with a total weight of roughly 17 kg. Several 3D-printed components and plates were also added to the structure for a more integrated, customized design. Locomotion relies on four Mecanum wheels, each driven independently by a DC motor, giving the robot omnidirectional movement and high maneuverability. To cut down on task execution time, the object-handling area sits at the front of the robot, so the manipulator never has to rotate backward during pick-and-place operations — a choice that meaningfully improves efficiency and shortens task duration.
blocks.zh: 底盘和底架结构主要由铝质剖面而成,给框既轻又稳. 基座测量长度65厘米,宽42厘米,高度56厘米,总重量约17公斤. 结构中还增加了几个3D打印的组件和板块,以进行更集成,更定制的设计. Locomotion依赖于四个Mecanum轮子,每个轮子都由DC马达独立驱动,赋予机器人全向运动和高度机动性. 为了缩短任务执行时间,对象处理区域坐落在机器人的前面,因此操纵者在挑拣和放置操作中从不需要向后旋转——这个选择能有意义地提高效率,缩短任务时间.

blocks.en: 2.1.2  Manipulator Design
blocks.zh: 2.1.2 操纵器设计

blocks.en: The manipulator arm has 5 joints and 3 links, ending in a purpose-built gripper, shown in Figure 2 . It reaches up to 65 cm and can carry a payload of roughly 450 g. The first three joints provide rotational motion about the robot’s principal axes, driven by three worm gearboxes powered by DC motors that supply enough torque and positioning precision. The fourth and fifth joints control gripper orientation using servo motors, letting the manipulator hold objects at different angles. Two more servo motors actuate the gripper fingers for grasping and releasing.
blocks.zh: 操纵器臂有5个关节和3个链接,以一个目的制造的抓刀结束,如图2所示。 它可达65厘米,载荷约为450克。 前三个关节提供机器人主轴的旋转运动,由DC发动机提供足够扭矩和定位精度的三台蠕虫变速箱驱动. 第四和第五关节使用伺服电动机控制抓取方向,使操纵器以不同角度控制物体. 又有两台伺服电动机 使抓住和释放的手指动起来

blocks.en: 2.2  Electrical Design
blocks.zh: 2.2 电气设计

blocks.en: Auriga’s @Work platform relies on two main custom electronic boards: one controls the manipulator arm, the other manages base movement. Keeping them separate allows the arm and base systems to be tested and debugged independently, which simplifies development and maintenance. The system also includes custom ESP32 [ 1 ] boards and a support board with op-amps and other ICs to improve the efficiency of the main boards, covered in detail below. An emergency button is wired into the main board for operational safety. Both main boards draw power from a four-cell 16000 mAh lithium-polymer battery, with voltage regulators supplying the correct operating voltage to each circuit.
blocks.zh: Auriga的@Work平台依靠两大定制电子板:一个控制操纵臂,另一个管理基部运动. 保持它们分开可以使臂和基系统独立测试和调试,从而简化了开发和维护. 该系统还包括定制的ESP32[1]板和一个带有op-amp和其他IC的辅助板,以提高主板的效率,详情见下文. 为操作安全起见,紧急按钮被接入主板. 两大板都从一个四电池16000mAh锂-聚合电池中抽取动力,电压调节器为每个电路提供正确的操作电压.

blocks.en: 2.2.1  Body Main Control Board
blocks.zh: 2.2.1 主要管制委员会

blocks.en: On this board, shown in Figure 4 , LM2596 switching regulators supply several voltage levels: 11 V for the encoders, 12 V for the NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, and 5 V for the ICs, microcontrollers, range-measurement sensors, gyroscopes, and CAN module. The gyroscopes and range-measurement sensors talk to the microcontroller over I 2 C, while data between the microcontroller and the Jetson Orin NX moves over a UART serial connection. The DC motors are driven by the HW-039 motor driver, rated for 6–27 V DC and a continuous current of 43 A, which suits high-power applications well. We also implemented a dedicated method for motor direction control that uses a single ESP32 pin to manage the direction of all four wheel motors; its functional simulation appears in Figure 3 a, and the fabricated PCB (top and bottom layers) is shown in Figures 3 b and 3 c. The PWM signal from the ESP32 is first converted into an analog voltage, then digitized using op-amps and a resistor-divider network to set up a stable reference. Two 74LS148 encoder ICs extract a 4-bit value from the resulting 16-bit range, giving up to 16 distinct directional states for the motors. These bits then pass through a 7404 NOT IC and a MUX/DeMUX IC to set the motor directions. The same approach is used to read data from the VL53L1X sensors through a MUX.
blocks.zh: 在这个板上,如图4所示,LM2596切换调节器提供几个电压级:编码器11V,NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX的12V,以及IC,微控制器,测距传感器,陀螺仪和CAN模块的5V. 陀螺仪和测距传感器在I 2 C上与微控制器交谈,而微控制器和Jetson Orin NX之间的数据则在UART序列连接上移动. DC发动机由HW-039型发动机驱动,定级为6–27 V DC,连续电流43 A,适合高功率应用. 我们还采用了一种专用的电动机方向控制方法,使用单一的ESP32披针来管理所有四个轮式电动机的方向;其功能模拟出现在图3a中,而编造的PCB(上层和下层)如图3b和3c所示. 来自ESP32的PWM信号首先被转换成模拟电压,然后使用op-amps和抵抗器-潜水器网络进行数字化,以建立稳定的参考. 两个74LS148编码器IC从产生的16位范围中提取出一个4位值,为马达放弃了16个截然不同的方向状态. 这些位点然后经过一个7404 NOT IC和一个MUX/DEMUX IC来设定运动方向. 同样的方法是通过MUX读取VL53L1X传感器的数据.

blocks.en: The emergency button on the body board can safely disable and re-enable the motors. Its safety circuit uses an IRF840 MOSFET and relays to reliably cut power when needed. Circuit design, PCB layout in Altium Designer, and hardware assembly were all carried out in-house by the electronics team.
blocks.zh: 车体板上的紧急按钮可以安全地禁用并重新启用马达. 其安全电路使用IRF840MOSFET,并在需要时进行中继以可靠切断电源. 电路设计,Altium Designer中的PCB布局,以及硬件组装均由电子团队内部进行.

blocks.en: 2.2.2  Arm’s Board
blocks.zh: 2.2.2 军火委员会

blocks.en: On this board, shown in Figure 5 , three LM2596 switching regulators supply different voltage levels: 8 V for one servo motor and three encoders, 6 V for three servo motors, and 5 V for the microcontroller and logic ICs. An AMS1117 regulator supplies an additional 3.3 V logic voltage for the DC motor driver. The board is built around a custom ESP32-based control unit, shown in Figure 6 . Motor actuation on the arm is handled by two HW-039 drivers and one L298N driver. The board also includes three relays for the emergency button system, four BJT transistors for switching, and a CAN module for communication with the main body board. Four servo motors are used here as well, driven using the same PWM-to-binary conversion method described above. To save ESP32 GPIO pins, an 8:1 analog multiplexer reads the microswitch signals used as reference inputs for motion initialization.
blocks.zh: 在这个板上,如图5所示,三个LM2596转换调节器提供不同的电压级: 8 V为1台伺服电动机和3台编码器,6 V为3台伺服电动机,5 V为微控制器和逻辑IC. 一台AMS1117调节器为DC发动机司机额外提供3.3V逻辑电压. 该板围绕一个基于ESP32的定制控制单元建造,如图6所示. 手臂上的汽车启动由两名HW-039司机和一名L298N司机处理. 该板还包括用于应急按钮系统的3台继电器,用于切换的4台BJT晶体管,以及用于与主机体板通信的CAN模块. 这里也使用四台伺服电动机,采用上述相同的PWM对二进制转换方法驱动. 为了保存ESP32 GPIO的针头,一个8:1的模拟多轴器读取用作运动初始化参考输入的微开关信号.

blocks.en: 2.2.3  Sensors

The Intel RealSense D435i [ 2 ] is an RGB-D camera that handles depth perception and visual data acquisition, feeding synchronized RGB and depth data to the robot’s main processor for perception and scene understanding.
blocks.zh: Intel RealSense D435i [2]是一台RGB-D相机,处理深度感知和视觉数据获取,将同步RGB和深度数据输入机器人的主要处理器,用于感知和场景理解.

blocks.en: The RPLIDAR A1 is a time-of-flight LiDAR that performs a 360-degree laser scan to detect surrounding obstacles. Mounted at the front of the robot, it is used mainly for mapping, navigation, and physical obstacle detection.
blocks.zh: RPLIDAR A1是飞行时段LiDAR,进行360度激光扫描以探测周围的障碍. 挂在机器人前部,主要用于测绘,导航,物理障碍探测.

blocks.en: We use the E38S6G5-100B-G24N rotary encoder, which measures shaft rotation to estimate angular displacement and velocity. It is used on both the arm and the mobile base to track joint positions, wheel velocities, and overall system state.
blocks.zh: 我们使用E38S6G5-100B-G24N旋转编码器,它测量旋转轴以估计角位移和速度。 它既用于臂部,也用于移动基部,以跟踪关节位置,轮速,以及整体系统状态.

blocks.en: The VL53L1X [ 3 ] is a time-of-flight distance sensor that covers LiDAR blind spots, improving collision avoidance during lateral and backward movement thanks to its speed and measurement accuracy.
blocks.zh: VL53L1X [3]是一种飞行时间距离传感器,覆盖LiDAR盲点,由于其速度和测量精度,在横向和后向移动期间改进了避免碰撞.

blocks.en: Robot orientation is measured using both CMPS14 and MPU6050 sensors. Their outputs are fused for a more reliable angle estimate, which improves localization accuracy.
blocks.zh: 机器人方向使用CMPS14和MPU6050传感器进行测量. 它们的输出被连接到一个更可靠的角度估计,这提高了本地化的准确性.

blocks.en: A load cell in the gripper measures grip force, with a resolution of 0.5 grams and a threshold of 10 grams. A sudden drop in force signals possible slippage or loss of the object. It also enables controlled force application, which keeps stress on the servo motors low and extends their lifespan.
blocks.zh: 抓取器中的负载细胞测量抓取力,分辨率为0.5克,阈值为10克. 武力突然下降的信号可能使物体滑落或丢失. 它还能够控制力应用,使伺服电动机的压力降低并延长其寿命。

blocks.en: 3.  Embedded Firmware, Communication, and ROS Architecture
blocks.zh: 3个 嵌入式固件、通信和ROS结构

blocks.en: 3.1  Embedded Firmware and Design
blocks.zh: 3.1 嵌入式固件和设计

blocks.en: The platform relies on three main processing units: one NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX module and two ESP32 microcontrollers. This split is meant to improve processing efficiency, keep subsystems in sync, and simplify overall data management.
blocks.zh: 该平台依靠三个主要处理单元:一个NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX模块和两个ESP32微控制器. 这种分割是为了提高处理效率,保持子系统同步,简化整体数据管理.

blocks.en: The NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX acts as the high-level computing platform, running the perception and control algorithms; its computational headroom lets it comfortably keep up with the system’s processing demands.
blocks.zh: NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX作为高级计算平台,运行感知和控制算法;它的计算头室让它舒适地跟上系统的处理需求.

blocks.en: Of the two embedded controllers, one sits in the lower chassis, where it manages communication between subsystems, handles data exchange, and gathers measurements from onboard sensors; in the system architecture this is the lower-level module referred to as the Navigation subsystem. The second ESP32 controller is dedicated to the robotic manipulator and is called the Arm module. It stays in contact with the Navigation subsystem, drives the arm actuators, and reads joint position feedback from the rotary encoders to keep motion under precise control.
blocks.zh: 在两个嵌入式控制器中,有一个坐落在下底盘中,管理子系统之间的通信,处理数据交换,并从机载传感器中收集测量数据;在系统架构中,这是称为导航子系统的下层模块. 第二个ESP32控制器是专用于机器人操纵器,被称为Arm模块. 它与导航子系统保持联系,驱动臂起动器,并读取旋转编码器的联合位置反馈,以保持运动精确控制.

blocks.en: 3.1.1  Embedded Firmware and Communication
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 嵌入式固件和通信

blocks.en: The embedded subsystem handles sensor data acquisition, deterministic communication between units, and real-time actuator control, with continuous, low-latency data exchange keeping the whole system in sync.
blocks.zh: 嵌入式子系统处理传感器数据采集,各单位之间的决定性通信,以及实时的激活器控制,持续,低纬度的数据交换使整个系统保持同步.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Hardware architecture and communication block diagram of the robotic system, illustrating the interconnection between the Nvidia Jetson, ESP32 controllers, sensors, and actuators.
blocks.zh: 图7:机器人系统的硬件架构和通信块图,说明Nvidia Jetson,ESP32控制器,传感器,和动因器之间的相互联系.

blocks.en: The Navigation controller acts as the central communication hub in the embedded architecture. It gathers sensor measurements and receives status updates from the ARM unit, then sends this data to the Jetson module over UART at 115200 bps, as shown in Figure 7 . In the other direction, high-level commands from the Jetson go to the Navigation unit, which either executes them directly or passes the relevant commands on to the ARM controller. Communication between the Navigation and Arm units runs over CAN, chosen for its resistance to electrical noise and suitability for reliable real-time embedded communication.
blocks.zh: 导航控制器作为嵌入式架构中的中央通信枢纽. 它收集传感器测量数据并接收ARM单元的状态更新,然后以115200 bps的高度将这些数据发送到UART上空的Jetson舱,如图7所示. 在另一个方向,来自Jetson的高级命令前往导航单位,导航单位要么直接执行,要么将相关命令传递给ARM控制器. 导航单位和Arm单位之间的通信运行于CAN上空,选择其抗电噪声和适合可靠的实时嵌入式通信.

blocks.en: Both embedded controllers run FreeRTOS-based firmware to make efficient use of resources, avoid task blocking, and guarantee deterministic scheduling. On the Arm controller, one task handles PID-based motor control while a separate task manages communication with the Navigation unit and the data it exchanges. The Navigation controller follows a similar pattern: one task acquires and preprocesses sensor data before sending it to the Jetson, another manages communication with the Arm unit, and a third runs PID-based velocity control for the navigation motors.
blocks.zh: 两个嵌入式控制器运行基于FreeRTOS的固件,以高效利用资源,避免任务阻塞,并保证定时调度. 在Arm控制器上,一个任务处理基于PID的电动机控制,而另一个任务管理与导航单位的通信及其交换的数据. 导航控制器遵循类似的模式:一项任务在发送到Jetson之前获取和预处理传感器数据,另一项管理与Arm单元的通信,第三项任务运行基于PID的导航马达速度控制.

blocks.en: 3.1.2  Sensor and Actuator Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 传感器和演员建筑

blocks.en: A range of sensors provides situational awareness and monitors the robot’s own state. For distance to obstacles, the LiDAR is supplemented with optical time-of-flight sensors (VL53L1X). Since these communicate over I 2 C, a hardware multiplexer managed by the Navigation controller allows them to run simultaneously. To keep pin usage on the controller low, a PWM-to-binary counter module is used as well.
blocks.zh: 一系列传感器提供情境意识并监测机器人自身的状态. 对于距离障碍物,LiDAR号被补充为光学飞行时间传感器(VL53L1X). 由于这些通过I 2 C 进行通信,由导航控制器管理的硬件多轴器允许它们同时运行. 为了保持控制器的针使用率低,也使用了PWM对二进制计数模块.

blocks.en: Inertial measurements come from the MPU6050 and CMPS14 sensors, which track the robot’s angular acceleration and orientation and communicate directly with the Navigation unit.

blocks.en: Several microswitches handle manipulator calibration, with their states sent to the Arm controller. Rotary encoders measure the angular position and velocity of the robot’s actuators, feeding the control loops.

blocks.en: All control computations run on the respective controllers, which then send the resulting commands to the motor drivers for execution.
blocks.zh: 所有控制计算都运行在相应的控制器上,然后将由此产生的命令发送到运动驱动器执行.

blocks.en: 3.2  Robot Communication, Workflow Infrastructure and ROS Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.2 机器人通信、工作流程基础设施和ROS结构

blocks.en: This section covers the software infrastructure behind the @Work Robot’s operation, from receiving a task order from the referee box down to executing low-level actuator commands on the embedded hardware. The system runs on the Robot Operating System (ROS) Noetic [ 4 ] under Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX onboard computer. The description below follows the system’s data flow in the order it occurs during a competition run: task reception, decision-making, cross-machine communication, task execution and navigation, perception integration, and finally low-level actuation over UART. The internal logic of each subsystem — how a path is planned, how an object is detected, how a manipulation is performed — is covered in its own dedicated section elsewhere in this report; here we focus purely on the architectural glue connecting these subsystems.
blocks.zh: 本节涵盖@Work Robot 操作背后的软件基础设施,从从裁判箱下方收到任务命令,到执行嵌入式硬件上的低级激活器命令. 该系统运行在Ubuntu 20.04 LTS下的机器人操作系统(ROS)Noetic [4]上,运行在机载的NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上. 以下描述遵循系统的数据流在竞争运行期间的顺序:任务接收,决策,跨机通信,任务执行和导航,感知集成,最后在UART之上低级激活. 每一个子系统的内部逻辑——路径是如何规划的,物体是如何探测的,如何进行操纵——都在本报告其他部分的专栏中阐述;在这里,我们完全侧重于连接这些子系统的建筑胶水.

blocks.en: 3.2.1  Task Reception and Multi-Master Communication
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 任务接待和多元通信

blocks.en: During a competition run, task orders come from the referee box via the atwork_commander [ 5 ] framework, which publishes a structured task description containing an ordered set of object manipulation subtasks, each with a source location, destination location, and object identifier. A dedicated decision-making node ( decision_making ) receives this description by subscribing to /atwork_commander/object_task . Once the task message arrives, the node unsubscribes from the topic, since only one task order is issued and processed per run.
blocks.zh: 在比赛运行期间,任务命令通过at_commander[5]框架从裁判箱中产生,该框架发布一个结构化的任务描述,包含一组命令对象操纵子任务,每个任务包含源位,目的地位置,以及对象标识符. 一个专门的决策节点(决策_决策)通过签署/atwork_commander/object_tobject获得此描述. 一旦任务消息到达,节点即不从话题上订阅,因为每次运行只发布和处理一个任务订单.

( Machine 1 ), while each competing robot runs an independent roscore on its onboard computer ( Machine 2 ). Getting task messages from the refbox
to the robot, and robot state back in the other direction, therefore means bridging

blocks.en: 3.2.2  Task Execution Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 任务执行管道

blocks.en: The decision_making node takes the parsed task order and works out an optimized sequence of pick-and-deliver operations, factoring in station locations, object types, and estimated travel and manipulation times. We don’t detail the internal optimization logic here, since it’s not part of the ROS communication architecture. From an infrastructure standpoint, this node acts as a single-shot translator: it converts the atwork_commander task representation into an internal, robot-specific one, and republishes the result once the full task order has been resolved.
blocks.zh: 决策节点采用解析的任务顺序,并设计出一个优化的串行顺序,在站点位置,对象类型,以及估计的旅行和操纵时间中进行计数. 我们并不详细描述内部优化逻辑, 从基础设施的角度来看,这个节点起到单发翻译的作用:它把工作_指挥员任务代表转换成内部的,机器人专用的,一旦全部任务命令解决后,就重排结果.

blocks.en: The resulting task sequence is published on a custom topic, decision , using a nested custom message type ( estrings , itself made up of a repeated string-array message estring ) that encodes each subtask as a row of string-serialized fields (object identifier, task status, workstation type, and target pose). This message is consumed exactly once, by the navigation and task-execution node described in Section 3.2.2 , marking the handoff between the decision layer and the execution layer.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的任务序列在一个自定义主题,决定上发布,使用一个嵌入式自定义消息类型(estrings,本身是由重复的字符串-阵列消息 estrings),将每个子任务编码为一行字符串序列化字段(对象标识符,任务状态,工作站类型,和目标姿势). 此信息被第3.2.2节描述的导航和任务执行节点消耗一次,这标志着决策层与执行层之间的交接.

blocks.en: A single node, main , orchestrates the robot centrally. It subscribes to the decision topic and keeps an internal task queue built from the received message. This node runs a finite-state machine that governs the robot’s high-level behavior — navigation, alignment, manipulation triggering, inter-task transitions — and it’s the point where all other subsystems, including localization, perception, and low-level actuation, come together. Because this node touches every other subsystem in the architecture, its outward-facing interfaces are described individually in the following subsections, while its internal state-machine logic and control algorithms are covered elsewhere in this report.
blocks.zh: 一个单一的节点,主, 指挥机器人集中。 它赞同决定主题,并保持从收到消息中构建内部任务队列. 这个节点运行着一个控制机器人高层次行为的有限状态机器——导航,对齐,操纵触发,任务间过渡——它也是所有其他子系统,包括本地化,感知,和低层次激活的集合点. 由于这个节点触及到架构中所有其他子系统,其外向接口在以下小节中单独描述,而其内部的状态-机器逻辑和控制算法则在本报告的其他地方涵盖.

blocks.en: 3.2.3  Sensor and Perception Interfacing
blocks.zh: 3.2.3 传感器和感知干扰

blocks.en: Low-level actuation and sensor acquisition are delegated to a dedicated microcontroller, reached through a Python bridge node, esp_comms , which talks to the microcontroller over a UART serial link ( /dev/ttyTHS0 ) using a fixed-format ASCII packet protocol. This node handles two jobs at once: serializing outgoing actuator commands into the packet format the microcontroller expects, and deserializing incoming sensor telemetry back into ROS messages.
blocks.zh: 低级的激活和传感器获取被委托给一个专用的微控制器,通过一个Python桥节点,esp_comms(esp_comms)到达,它利用一个固定格式的ASCII包协议与微控制器就UART序列链接(/dev/ttyTHS0)进行交谈. 这个节点同时处理两个任务:将输出的激活器命令序列化为微控制器所期望的包格式,并将输入的传感器遥测解回ROS消息.

blocks.en: On the outgoing side, esp_comms subscribes to motor4 (wheel actuation commands) and arm_datas (manipulator commands), both published by main , and merges them into a single serial packet sent to the microcontroller each cycle. On the incoming side, it parses the microcontroller’s serial reply and republishes the extracted data as three separate topics: encoder4 (wheel encoder readings), VL (time-of-flight range array), and cmps (compass heading), all consumed by main for localization. The microcontroller’s arm-response status isn’t published as a topic at all; instead it’s written directly to the ROS parameter server ( arm_response ) and polled by main each control cycle. We use this parameter-server channel deliberately, as a lightweight, low-latency status flag rather than a queued topic, since only the most recent value ever matters to the state machine.
blocks.zh: 在向外侧,esp_comms订阅马达4(轮激活命令)和arm_data(操纵命令),两者均由主发布,并合并成一个发送到每个周期的微控制器的单个序列包. 在进入的一侧,它将微控制器的序列回复解析,并将提取的数据重新编译为三个独立的话题:编码器4(轮码读数),VL(飞行时间范围阵列)和cmps(compass head),全部由主机消耗,用于本地化. 微控制器的臂部响应状态根本不是作为一个话题发布的,而是直接写到ROS参数服务器(arm_response)上,并由每个控制周期的主计数. 我们有意使用这个参数服务器频道,作为轻量级,低纬度状态的旗帜,而不是排队的话题,因为只有最新的值对状态机器有影响.

blocks.en: The main node fuses the encoder, compass, and range data internally to maintain the robot’s global pose estimate; this fusion logic is covered in the localization section and isn’t repeated here.
blocks.zh: 主节点将编码器、指南针和范围数据装入内部,以维持机器人的全球姿势估计;这种聚变逻辑包含在本地化部分,在此不再重复。

blocks.en: Visual perception is handled by two cooperating nodes, camera_node and vision_node , both part of the arm package. camera_node initializes and continuously polls an Intel RealSense D455 camera, and instead of publishing raw color and depth frames over ROS topics, it writes them directly into two POSIX shared-memory segments ( image_frame and depth_frame ). vision_node maps the same shared-memory segments and reads the latest available frames directly, skipping ROS message serialization entirely for this high-bandwidth path. This mirrors the shared-memory pattern used elsewhere in the team’s software stack for large image payloads.
blocks.zh: 视觉感知由两个合作的节点,相机_节点和视觉_节点处理,两者都是臂包的一部分. camera_node 初始化并持续投票Intel RealSense D455相机,它没有在ROS主题上发布原始的颜色和深度框架,而是直接将其写入两个POSIX共享-记忆片段(图像_帧和深度_帧). vision_node 映射相同的共享模组片段并直接读取最新的可用帧,完全跳过ROS消息序列化这个高带宽路径. 这反映了团队软件堆栈中用于大型图像有效载荷的共享记忆模式。

blocks.en: Beyond camera-based perception, vision_node also manages a 2D LiDAR unit (RPLidar) on its own, without a separate ROS driver node; the LiDAR is opened directly as a serial device from within vision_node on a dedicated background thread, and its scan data is consumed internally by the same node rather than published on a topic. This keeps all mapping-relevant sensing — camera and LiDAR — inside a single perception process.
blocks.zh: 除了基于相机的感知,Video_node还单独管理一个2D LiDAR单元(RPLidar),没有单独的ROS驱动节点;LiDAR从视觉_node内部直接作为串行设备在专用背景线上打开,其扫描数据由同一个节点内部消耗,而不是在一个主题上发布. 这使得所有与绘图有关的感知——相机和LiDAR——都保持在一个单一的感知过程中.

blocks.en: vision_node and main coordinate through one topic plus the ROS parameter server. vision_node publishes its detection output — object, hole, or station-relative measurements, depending on the active mode — on /vision_out as a two-dimensional array packed into a single Int32MultiArray message with explicit layout dimensions. main , on the other hand, doesn’t command the perception mode through a topic; instead it writes the desired operating mode and target object identifier, along with the robot’s current global pose, to the parameter server ( mode , obj , x , y , theta ), which vision_node polls every cycle. This keeps the perception node a passive follower of the task-execution state machine, with no dedicated command topic or service needed.
blocks.zh: 通过一个话题加上ROS参数服务器实现视觉_节点和主坐标. vision_node 发布其检测输出——对象,孔,或站点相对的测量,视活动模式而定——在/vision_out上作为二维阵列包装成一个具有明确布局维度的单一Int32 MultiArray消息. 另一方面,主要不通过一个话题来命令感知模式;而是将理想的操作模式和目标对象标识符,连同机器人目前的全球姿势,写到参数服务器(模式,obj,x,y,theta),即每个周期的视觉_节点民调. 这使得感知节点成为任务执行状态机器的被动跟踪者,不需要专门的指令主题或服务.

blocks.en: 3.2.4  System Integration and Summary
blocks.zh: 3.2.4 系统整合和总结

blocks.en: The system comes up through two independent ROS launch files rather than one unified configuration. The first, esp.launch , starts the esp_comms bridge and the main navigation/task-execution node together, reflecting how tightly they’re coupled through the motor, encoder, and arm-command topics described in Section 3.2.3 . The second, vision.launch , starts camera_node and vision_node together, reflecting their shared-memory coupling from Section 3.2.3 . This split lets the perception subsystem and the navigation/actuation subsystem be started, restarted, and debugged independently during development and testing.
blocks.zh: 该系统通过两个独立的ROS发射文件而不是一个统一的配置而出现. 第一,esp.launch,启动esp_comms桥和主要导航/任务执行节点,反映它们通过3.2.3节所述马达、编码器和臂指挥主题的紧密结合。 第二, 视觉. 启动, 开始相机_ 节点和视觉_ 节点一起, 反映它们来自 section 的共享- memery 耦合 3.2.3 (中文(简体) ). 这种分割使得感知子系统与导航/激活子系统在开发与测试过程中能够独立启动,重启,调试.

blocks.en: 4.  Computer Vision and Perception
blocks.zh: 4. 计算机视野和观念

blocks.en: 4.1  Mapping Subsystem
blocks.zh: 4.1 绘图子系统

blocks.en: The mapping subsystem pairs a LiDAR sensor with the Hector SLAM [ 7 ] algorithm to simultaneously estimate the robot’s pose and build a two-dimensional map of the environment.
blocks.zh: 绘图子系统将一个LiDAR传感器与Hector SLAM [7]算法对齐,以同时估计机器人的姿势,并构建环境的二维地图.

blocks.en: A key feature of Hector SLAM is that it doesn’t depend on wheel odometry or IMU measurements, relying solely on laser scan data for localization and map construction. This makes the system robust to odometry drift and sensor noise.
blocks.zh: Hector SLAM的一个关键特征是它不依赖于轮面测量或IMU测量,仅依靠激光扫描数据进行本地化和地图构造. 这使得系统能够坚固地进行偏振漂移和传感器噪声.

blocks.en: The occupancy grid map is updated continuously across mission phases, including when it encounters static and dynamic obstacles. This keeps localization consistent and navigation reliable throughout task execution.
blocks.zh: 占用网图在特派团各阶段不断更新,包括遇到静态和动态障碍时。 这在整个任务执行过程中保持了本地化的一致性和导航可靠性.

blocks.en: We chose Hector SLAM for its sensor independence, its accuracy in small- to medium-scale indoor environments, and its computational efficiency, which suits real-time operation on embedded hardware.
blocks.zh: 我们选择Hector SLAM是因为它的传感器独立性,它在中小型室内环境中的准确性,以及它的计算效率,这适合嵌入式硬件上的实时操作.

blocks.en: 4.2  Image Processing and Computer Vision
blocks.zh: 4.2 图像处理和计算机远景

blocks.en: The computer vision system is built around six primary operating modes, triggered by control signals from the robot’s main module. It processes visual data and returns outputs for decision-making and task execution.
blocks.zh: 计算机视觉系统是围绕6个主操作模式构建的,由机器人主模块的控制信号触发. 它处理视觉数据和返回产出,以供决策和任务执行。

blocks.en: 4.2.1  Neural Network Development
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 神经网络发展

blocks.en: For real-time perception, we built a custom object detection and segmentation framework based on the YOLO [ 8 ] architecture, optimized for the target hardware.
blocks.zh: 对于实时感知,我们基于YOLO[8]架构构建了一个定制对象检测和分区框架,为目标硬件进行了优化.

blocks.en: We built a dedicated dataset to ensure robustness and generalization across varied environmental conditions. Images were captured directly from the robot’s operational environment for realistic training scenarios, and synthetic images with varied backgrounds and lighting were generated to broaden generalization further. Pixel-level manual annotation was also carried out to support segmentation and improve detection accuracy.
blocks.zh: 我们建立了一个专门的数据集,以确保在各种环境条件中保持稳健性和普遍性。 图像是直接从机器人的操作环境中获取的,以便进行现实的培训,并生成具有不同背景和照明的合成图像,以进一步扩大一般化。 还进行了像素级人工注释,以支持分解和提高检测准确性。

blocks.en: Combining real, synthetic, and carefully annotated data gives the framework high detection precision and reliable segmentation, enabling real-time perception in dynamic environments. Figure 11 shows the system’s real-time performance, with simultaneous detection, tracking, and physical dimension estimation of objects in the robot’s surroundings. The values shown in the figure are the estimated real-world width (RW) and distance (D) from the sensor.
blocks.zh: 结合真实的,合成的,精心注释的数据,使框架具有较高的检测精度和可靠的分解性,使得在动态环境中能够实时感知. 图11显示系统的实时性能,同时对机器人周围的物体进行探测、跟踪和物理维度估计。 图中显示的数值是估计真实世界宽度(RW)和传感器距离(D).

blocks.en: Figure 11: Real-time object detection and classification.
blocks.zh: 图11:实时物体探测与分类.

blocks.en: The final dataset has 61,285 training images and 3,879 validation images, for 65,164 annotated samples in total. Roughly 6,000 of these (about 9%) are original real-world images, with the remaining 59,164 generated through data augmentation for diversity. The dataset spans varied lighting conditions, object orientations, and backgrounds to improve robustness and generalization. All samples were manually checked for annotation consistency and segmentation accuracy.
blocks.zh: 最终数据集共有61 285个培训图像和3 879个验证图像,共计65 164个注解样本。 其中大约6 000幅(约9%)是真实世界的原始图像,其余59 164幅是通过数据扩充生成的,以促进多样性。 数据集跨度各异的照明条件,对象方向,以及背景,以提高稳健性和通俗性. 所有样本都经过人工检查,以确定说明的一致性和分区的准确性。

blocks.en: YOLOv11s-Seg (small segmentation variant), chosen to balance accuracy against computational cost for real-time deployment.
blocks.zh: YOLOv11s-Seg(小区段变体),选取,以平衡实时部署的计算成本的准确性.

blocks.en: Simultaneous object detection and instance segmentation, giving both bounding-box localization and pixel-level object mask prediction.
blocks.zh: 同时对对象进行检测和实例分割,同时给予边框定位和像素级对象遮罩预测.

blocks.en: Training combines bounding box regression loss, classification loss, objectness loss, and segmentation loss to jointly optimize localization accuracy and mask quality.
blocks.zh: 训练结合了边框回归损失,分类损失,对象损失,分块损失,共同优化定位精度和遮盖质量.

blocks.en: The model was trained to convergence using performance-based early stopping, while monitoring mean Average Precision (mAP), precision, and recall to keep generalization stable.
blocks.zh: 该模型通过基于性能的早期停止来进行趋同培训,而监测则意味着平均精度(mAP),精度,以及召回,以保持通化的稳定.

blocks.en: The model trained for 50 epochs at a batch size of 32. The training and validation curves show stable convergence across all loss components — box, classification, segmentation, and distribution focal loss — as shown in Figure 12 . Both training and validation losses drop consistently with no sign of overfitting, which points to good generalization.
blocks.zh: 该型号为50个纪元训练,分批规模32. 如图12所示,训练和验证曲线显示,所有损失组成部分——箱、分类、分块和分配焦损失——都趋于一致。 培训和鉴定损失均持续下降,没有过度调整的迹象,这表明通用性很好。

blocks.en: The model reaches a precision and recall of roughly 0.99 for both bounding box and segmentation outputs. The evaluation results also show an mAP50 near 0.995 and an mAP50-95 of about 0.98 for bounding boxes and 0.93 for segmentation masks.
blocks.zh: 该模型的精确度和召回率大约为0.99,既用于边框,也用于分块输出。 评价结果还显示一个近0.995的mAP50,一个约0.98的mAP50-95用于捆绑箱,0.93用于分割口罩.

blocks.en: The final deployed model runs at 17 FPS on the target hardware, confirming it’s fast enough for real-time autonomous operation.
blocks.zh: 最终部署的模型在目标硬件上运行于17 FPS,证实其速度足够实时自主操作.

blocks.en: Figure 12: Training and validation loss curves, illustrating convergence across all loss components.
blocks.zh: 图12:培训和鉴定损失曲线,说明所有损失部分的趋同。

blocks.en: 4.2.2  Operational Modes
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 业务方式

blocks.en: This mode detects primary task-related objects using the YOLOv11s-Seg network, identifying both basic industrial components (e.g., bolts, nuts, rods) and more complex tools (e.g., drills, motors, bearings).
blocks.zh: 这种模式使用YOLOv11s-Seg网络检测与任务相关的主物体,既识别基本工业部件(如螺栓,坚果,棒子),又识别更复杂的工具(如钻头,马达,轴承).

blocks.en: By combining depth information with camera intrinsic parameters, the system computes, for each detected object: real-world dimensions (width/height), object orientation, the three-dimensional distance between the gripper and object center ( x , y , z x,y,z ), and the gripper opening distance needed for a successful grasp.
blocks.zh: 通过将深度信息与相机内在参数相结合,系统对每个被检测对象进行计算:真实世界维度(width/height),对象方向,抓取器与对象中心之间的三维距离(x,y,z,y,z),以及成功抓取所需的抓取器开口距离.

blocks.en: Because some objects look visually similar, an additional dimension-based classification step assigns subcategories based on estimated physical measurements.
blocks.zh: 由于一些物体看起来类似视觉,一个额外的基于维度的分类步骤根据估计的物理测量来分配子类别.

blocks.en: For example, a detected white rod is classified as a Large Rod if its estimated width exceeds 35 mm, and as a Small Rod otherwise. Spatial filtering constraints — such as a 1 meter maximum detection range — also help filter out irrelevant background detections.
blocks.zh: 例如,如果检测到的白色棒的宽度估计超过35毫米,则将其归类为大棒,否则则将其归类为小棒。 空间过滤限制——如1米最大检测范围——也帮助过滤出无关背景检测.

blocks.en: Figure 13 illustrates this post-processing step, where objects are sorted into subcategories (e.g., small vs. large) based on their RW and D as defined above.
blocks.zh: 图13说明了这一处理后步骤,即根据上面定义的RW和D将物体排序为子类(如小对大)。

blocks.en: Figure 13: Subcategory classification based on estimated physical width (RW) and distance filtering (D).
blocks.zh: 图13:根据估计物理宽度(RW)和距离过滤(D)分类的子类.

blocks.en: Some objects start out under broader parent classes and get refined into specific child classes during post-processing. This hierarchical approach is needed because certain objects (e.g., large and small rods or nuts) look too similar for the network to reliably tell apart by appearance alone. Final categorization instead relies on estimated physical properties such as real-world dimensions and aspect ratio.
blocks.zh: 一些物体从更广泛的家长班开始,在加工后被精炼成特定的儿童班。 之所以需要这种分级方法,是因为某些物体(如大细棒或坚果)看起来太相似,网络本身就无法可靠地分辨出来. 最后的分类则依赖于估计的物理特性,如现实世界的维度和侧面比。

blocks.en: This mode detects insertion points or empty target spaces using a lightweight YOLOv8n segmentation model, chosen for faster inference while keeping accuracy adequate.
blocks.zh: 这种模式使用轻量级的YOLOv8n分区模型来检测插入点或空目标空格,选择以更快的推论,同时保持足够的精度.

blocks.en: Since insertion points (e.g., rod slots and nut recesses) can look similar from a top-down view, appearance-based classification alone isn’t enough. Detected shapes are first sorted into four geometric classes — Screw, Hexagon, Polygon, and Rectangle — and then refined based on aspect ratio and real-world dimensional thresholds.
blocks.zh: 由于插入点(如棒槽和坚果底座)从上而下看可以看起来相似, 检测到的形状首先被排序为四个几何类——螺旋,六角,多边形,和矩形,然后根据尺寸比和现实世界维度阈值进行精炼.

blocks.en: Objects are classified by their geometric characteristics. Rectangular shapes longer than 70 mm are identified as rod slots, and shorter ones as nut sockets. Nut sockets are further split by width: those under 35 mm are small nuts, and those above are large nuts. Figure 14 shows this classification process, with objects labeled small or large based on these real-world dimensional thresholds (RW and RL).
blocks.zh: 物体按其几何特征分类. 长于70毫米的矩形被确定为棒槽,较短的则被确定为坚果插座. 坚果套座进一步被宽度分割:35毫米以下的是小坚果,以上是大坚果. 图14显示了这种分类过程,对象根据这些现实世界的维阈值(RW和RL)被标记为小或大.

blocks.en: Figure 14: Geometric classification of objects based on real-world length (RL) and width (RW) thresholds for precision placement.
blocks.zh: 图 14:根据真实世界长度(RL)和宽度(RW)阈值对物体进行几何分类,用于精确放置.

blocks.en: This mode continuously updates the environment map with both virtual and physical obstacles, enabling dynamic path planning and safe navigation.
blocks.zh: 该模式以虚拟和物理障碍不断更新环境图,使动态路径规划和安全导航成为可能.

blocks.en: Red and yellow tapes are detected with the YOLOv11s segmentation model. To account for the offset between the camera and LiDAR coordinate frames, a trigonometric transformation is applied: the horizontal distance is calculated with the Pythagorean theorem from the camera height and measured depth, then corrected for the camera–LiDAR spatial offset.
blocks.zh: 红色和黄色磁带用YOLOv11s分片模型检测. 为计算相机和LiDAR坐标框之间的偏移,采用了三角变换法:水平距离用来自相机高度和测量深度的毕达哥里定理计算,然后纠正相机–LiDAR空间偏移.

blocks.en: Each detected obstacle is then projected onto the global map with its estimated size and orientation, and a corresponding flag is sent to the control unit. As shown in Figure 15 , the system segments the tape obstacles and computes their real-world dimensions and distance, which are needed for accurate spatial projection and map updating.
blocks.zh: 然后将每个探测到的障碍都投射到全球地图上,并附有其估计大小和方向,并将相应的旗帜发送给控制单位。 如图15所示,该系统分解磁带障碍,计算出其真实世界的尺寸和距离,这是准确空间投影和地图更新所需的。

blocks.en: Figure 15: Segmentation and dimension estimation of virtual tape obstacles for global map projection.
blocks.zh: 图15:全球地图投影虚拟磁带障碍的分割和维度估计。

blocks.en: Physical obstacles are found by comparing real-time LiDAR point cloud data against the original static map. The DBSCAN [ 9 ] clustering algorithm groups nearby points and filters out noise, with the maximum distance between neighboring points (epsilon, ε \varepsilon ) and the minimum cluster size (MinSamples) set accordingly.
blocks.zh: 物理障碍是通过将实时LiDAR点云数据与原静态地图进行比较而发现的. DBSCAN [9] 集群算法组位附近点并过滤出噪声,相邻点之间最大距离(epsilon, \\ varepsilon)和最小集群大小(MinSamples)相应设定.

blocks.en: Newly found clusters are flagged as dynamic obstacles and added to the updated map, and the control module is notified to trigger replanning. Figure 16 shows the resulting local map, with LiDAR-detected clusters processed and represented as distinct physical obstacles for real-time navigation.
blocks.zh: 新发现的集群被标记为动态障碍并添加到更新的地图中,并通知控制模块以触发重新规划. 图16显示由此产生的本地地图,处理LiDAR-探测集群,并将其作为实时导航的显著物理障碍。

blocks.en: Figure 16: Real-time obstacle representation in the occupancy grid map based on LiDAR data and DBSCAN clustering.
blocks.zh: 图16:基于LiDAR数据和DBSCAN集群在占用网格图中的实时障碍表示.

blocks.en: These modes align the robot with the center of a target station. Detection starts by extracting the front edge of the station with Canny edge detection, followed by line fitting using RANSAC (Random Sample Consensus) [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 这些模式使机器人与目标站中心一致. 检测开始于提取站前边缘的坎尼边缘探测器,然后使用RANSAC(Random样品共识)[10].

blocks.en: We chose RANSAC because experiments showed it outperforms the traditional Hough Line Transform, with better robustness to noise and outliers while still reliably estimating the dominant line.
blocks.zh: 我们选择RANSAC是因为实验显示它比传统的Hough Line Transform要好, 更强壮的噪音和异常,同时仍然可靠地估计主线。

blocks.en: From this, the system computes both the translational displacement needed for lateral alignment and the angular offset needed for orientation correction. Figure 17 shows the edge detection and line fitting process on different stations, where the red line marks the estimated dominant edge and the blue point marks the calculated center for robot alignment.
blocks.zh: 从中,系统计算横向对齐所需的翻译转移和定向校正所需的角抵消。 图17显示了不同车站的边缘检测和线条配置过程,其中红线标注了估计主线边缘,蓝点标注了机器人对齐的计算中心.
(b) 国家

blocks.en: Figure 17: Robot alignment process using Canny edge detection and RANSAC line fitting: (a) detection of the station front edge, and (b) center point estimation for translational and angular correction.
blocks.zh: 图17:利用坎尼边缘探测和RANSAC线路配置的机器人对接过程:(a)对车站前缘的探测,以及(b)翻译和角修正的中点估计.

blocks.en: This mode checks whether a station has room for object placement. The system scans the station regions with a virtual circle of 5 cm radius, scaled by distance. When it finds an empty spot, the coordinates go to the control unit for the placement action that follows. Figure 18 shows this check, with a green circle marking a detected empty spot and a red circle marking an occupied region, preventing placement errors.
blocks.zh: 这个模式检查车站是否有放置物体的空间. 系统以5厘米半径的虚拟圆形扫描各站区,按距离缩放. 当它找到一个空位时,坐标会转到控制单位进行随后的放置动作. 图18显示了这一检查,一个绿色圆形标记一个检测到的空位,一个红色圆形标记一个被占区域,防止放置错误.
(b) 国家

blocks.en: Figure 18: Emptiness check using a virtual scanning circle: (a) identification of an empty placement spot, and (b) detection of an occupied area.
blocks.zh: 图18:利用虚拟扫描圆圈进行安放检查:(a) 确定空位,(b) 发现一个占用区。

blocks.en: This mode detects containers and reports their center coordinates to the control unit. The red and blue container classes are part of the main YOLO Segmentation V11s model and are only detected when the control system explicitly requests it. Once a container is found, the system computes the real-world distance from the gripper to the container center (X, Y, Z) and publishes it.
blocks.zh: 这种模式检测容器,并将其中心坐标报告给控制单位. 红色和蓝色的容器类别是YOLO分离V11s的主要模型的一部分,只有在控制系统明确要求时才被检测到. 一旦发现容器,系统就计算出从钳子到容器中心(X,Y,Z)的真实世界距离,并出版.

blocks.en: To keep measurements reliable, data is only published once the entire container is visible in the camera’s field of view, verified by width and height checks that rule out erroneous center calculations from partial views. Figure 19 shows the detection of red and blue containers, where the system checks real-world dimensions (e.g., 146 × \times 174 mm) to confirm the container is fully in view (labeled ‘Size:OK’) before publishing coordinates.
blocks.zh: 为了保持测量的可靠性,只有在整个容器在照相机的视野中可见之后,才公布数据,通过宽度和高度检查加以核实,从而排除了从部分视图中得出错误的中心计算。 图19显示对红色和蓝色容器的探测情况,该系统在公布坐标之前检查真实世界的尺寸(例如146xx\times 174mm)以确认容器的位置。

blocks.en: Figure 19: Real-time container detection and visibility verification for accurate center coordinate estimation.
blocks.zh: 图19 实时容器检测和可见度核查,以准确的中央坐标估计.

blocks.en: 5.  Control and Planning Architecture
blocks.zh: 5.五. 控制和规划结构

blocks.en: 5.1  Localization and Mapping
blocks.zh: 5.1 本地化和绘图

blocks.en: The map produced by the Computer Vision module is exported as a text file representing a discrete two-dimensional occupancy grid, stored for later use in navigation and decision-making.
blocks.zh: 计算机视野模块制作的地图作为代表离散二维占用网格的文本文件导出,存储后用于导航和决策.

blocks.en: Using this map together with the robot’s kinematic model and onboard sensor measurements — gyroscope and wheel encoder data — the robot’s global pose (position and orientation) is estimated in the world coordinate frame. This pose estimate and the occupancy grid then feed into path planning toward the target location.
blocks.zh: 使用这张地图加上机器人的动能模型和机载传感器测量数据——陀螺仪和轮式编码器数据——机器人的全球姿势(位置和方向)在世界坐标框架内得到估计. 这构成估计值,然后占用网格输入通往目标地点的路径规划。

blocks.en: 5.2  Decision-Making and Path Planning
blocks.zh: 5.2 决策和道路规划

blocks.en: The robot follows a structured decision-making and planning pipeline for task execution. Given a list of tasks, it first works out the optimal execution order with a dedicated decision-making algorithm, then a path planning algorithm computes an efficient route to each target location.
blocks.zh: 机器人遵循结构化的决策和规划管道执行任务. 考虑到一系列任务,它首先用专用的决策算法制定出最佳执行命令,然后一个路径规划算法计算出每个目标位置的有效路由.

blocks.en: 5.2.1  Decision-Making
blocks.zh: 5.2.1 决定的作出

blocks.en: The decision-making module evaluates all feasible orderings of task execution. Each candidate sequence is scored with a cost function that factors in path length and complexity, object type, target station type, number of empty slots, and the priority assigned to each task.
blocks.zh: 决策单元评价所有可行的任务执行命令。 每个候选序列的得分具有成本函数,该函数在路径长度和复杂度,对象类型,目标站类型,空位数量,以及分配给每项任务的优先级等方面进行考量.

blocks.en: Sequences that cost more than previously evaluated candidates are pruned along the way, so the system converges on the most cost-efficient task sequence, as shown in the optimization workflow in Figure 21 .
blocks.zh: 如图21的优化工作流程所示,费用超过以前评价的候选人的顺序沿途被挤压,因此系统集中到最具成本效益的任务序列上。

blocks.en: The weights and coefficients for each cost parameter were tuned empirically through systematic experimentation to get robust decision-making performance.
blocks.zh: 每个成本参数的权重和系数通过系统的实验在经验上加以调整,以取得强有力的决策业绩。

blocks.en: Figure 21: Flowchart of the task sequence optimization process, illustrating the iterative cost evaluation and neighbor sequence generation to achieve the most efficient execution plan.
blocks.zh: 图21:任务序列优化流程流程图,说明迭代成本评价及相邻序列生成,实现最有效的执行计划.

blocks.en: 5.2.2  Path Planning
blocks.zh: 5.2.2 道路规划

blocks.en:
The navigation system generates a collision-free trajectory from the robot’s current pose to the target location given by the Decision Making module. Since the competition environment is a known occupancy grid, global path planning uses the A* search algorithm [ 12 ] , giving an efficient, near-optimal path around static obstacles.
To speed things up [ 13 ] , A*’s open set is implemented as a Min-Heap priority queue, cutting the time complexity of selecting the next node from O ⁡ ( n ) O(n) to O ⁡ ( log ⁡ n ) O(\log n) — a real gain for longer paths in particular.
The node evaluation function is defined as follows.
blocks.zh:
导航系统产生一个无碰撞轨道,从机器人目前的姿势到决策模块给出的目标位置。 由于竞争环境是已知的占用网格,因此全球路径规划使用A*搜索算法[12],给出了围绕静态障碍的有效,近乎最佳的路径.
为了加快速度[13],AQQs开放的集作为敏希普优先排队执行,将选择下一个节点的时间复杂性从OQQ(n)O(n)到OQX(logX)O(\logn)O(\logn)——这是特别是更长路径的真正收益.
节点评价职能的定义如下.

This safety term biases the planner toward paths with more obstacle clearance, keeping the robot closer to the center of corridors and reducing collision risk from localization or tracking errors.
Once the optimal path is generated, it’s passed to the motion controller as the reference trajectory. A PID-based path tracking controller continuously minimizes position and heading errors as the robot follows the planned route. During execution, LiDAR measurements are monitored in real time for unexpected obstacles; if a potential collision is detected, the robot stops immediately, updates the navigation map, replans the path, and resumes.
The whole navigation framework is implemented in C++ and runs in real time on the NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, giving reliable, responsive autonomous navigation throughout the competition environment.

blocks.en: 5.3  Manipulator Structure and Object Handling Algorithm
blocks.zh: 5.3 操纵器结构和物体处理算法

blocks.en: The robot’s 5-degree-of-freedom (5-DOF) manipulator is controlled by an ESP32 microcontroller. High-level target poses and Cartesian coordinates are computed on the Jetson Orin NX and sent to the ESP32 for low-level execution.
blocks.zh: 机器人的5度自由(5-DOF)操纵器由ESP32微控制器控制. 高级目标姿势和笛卡尔坐标在Jetson Orin NX上计算,并送往ESP32进行低级执行.

blocks.en: Once it receives the target pose, the manipulator computes the corresponding joint angles from its inverse kinematic model. These joint commands are then applied to reach the end-effector position and orientation needed for object manipulation.
blocks.zh: 操纵者收到目标姿势后,会从其反动模型中计算相应的关节角. 然后应用这些联合命令,达到最终效果器的位置和对象操纵所需的方向.

blocks.en: 5.3.1  Object Placement Slots
blocks.zh: 5.3.1 物体放置槽

blocks.en: As mentioned earlier, the robot has a set of object placement slots at its front. These slots move linearly along the horizontal axis (left and right). During pickup and placement, a predefined control algorithm positions the slots so the target slot sits directly in front of the manipulator.
blocks.zh: 如前所述,机器人在其前方设有一组物体放置槽. 这些槽沿水平轴(左右)线性移动. 在拾取和放置时,一个预定义的控制算法将插槽定位,使目标插槽直接坐落在操纵器前.

blocks.en: Since the system always knows the exact position of each slot through this precise control, no extra scanning, perception, or processing is needed to find slot positions during pickup or placement. This cuts computational overhead and makes object-handling more efficient and reliable.
blocks.zh: 由于系统总是通过这种精确的控制来了解每个槽的确切位置,因此在接货或放置时不需要额外的扫描,感知或处理来找到槽位置. 这削减了计算间接费用,使处理对象更有效和更可靠。

blocks.en: 5.3.2  Object Picking

At the start of the picking procedure, the robot first checks it has enough storage capacity for a new object. If there’s room, the manipulator moves to a predefined hovering position above the target station.
blocks.zh: 在采摘程序开始时,机器人首先检查它有足够的存储能力来接收一个新的物体. 如果有空间,操纵者会移动到目标站上方预先确定的徘徊位置。

blocks.en: Once it receives the precise pose of the target object from the perception module, the manipulator approaches and grasps it with the end-effector gripper. Real-time load-cell measurements then verify the grasp; once confirmed, the object is lifted and moved to the robot’s front storage compartment, where it stays secured until delivery.
blocks.zh: 一旦它从感知模块中得到了目标对象的精确姿势,操纵者就接近并用最终效应者抓取它. 实时负载细胞测量然后验证抓取;一旦确认,物体被抬升并移动到机器人的前储舱,在交付前一直处于安全状态.

blocks.en: 5.3.3  Object Placement
blocks.zh: 5.3.3 物品放置

blocks.en: During placement, the manipulator retrieves the object from the front storage compartment and begins the placement procedure. The system first identifies the available section of the target station for placement.
blocks.zh: 在放置过程中,操纵者从前储舱中取回物体,并开始放置程序. 该系统首先确定目标站的可用路段进行布置.

blocks.en: Once a free slot is found, visual data from the perception module gives the precise coordinates of the target location. From this, the manipulator computes the required joint configuration and aligns the end-effector with the placement area.
blocks.zh: 一旦找到自由槽,来自感知模块的视觉数据给出了目标位置的精确坐标. 从此,操纵者会计算所需的联合配置,并将最终效果器与放置区域对齐.

blocks.en: Finally, the gripper releases the object in a controlled manner, completing the placement.
blocks.zh: 最后,握手以控制的方式释放物体,完成放置.

blocks.en: 5.3.4  Performance Evaluation
To keep the placement procedure reliable, we set specific operational constraints and performance metrics:
blocks.zh: 为了保证安置程序的可靠性,我们制定了具体的业务限制和业绩计量:

blocks.en: Operational Speed: Each manipulator joint can reach a maximum angular velocity of 40 ∘ / s 40^{\circ}/\mathrm{s} . To keep motion controllable and stable and to ensure safe operation in the lab, though, joint velocities are capped between 15 ∘ / s 15^{\circ}/\mathrm{s} and 20 ∘ / s 20^{\circ}/\mathrm{s} , depending on conditions.
blocks.zh: 操作速度:每个操纵器关节可以达到最大角速度40 ∘/s 40 ^{\circ}/\mathrm{s}. 为了保持运动的可控性和稳定性,并确保实验室的安全运行,联合速度在15 ∘/s 15^{\crc}/\mathrm{s}和20 ∘/s 20^{\crc}/\mathrm{s}之间上限,视条件而定.

blocks.en: Grasping Success Rate: We ran a series of grasping experiments on objects of various shapes, sizes, and surface properties to evaluate the manipulator’s performance, testing each object over 20 independent trials. A trial counted as successful if the robot could grasp, lift, and place the object at the target location without dropping it. Table 4 summarizes the resulting success rates.
blocks.zh: 获取成功率 : 我们在各种形状、大小和表面特性的物体上进行了一系列的把握实验,以评估操纵者的性能,在20次独立试验中测试每个物体。 如果机器人能够抓住、抬起、把物体放在目标位置而不丢弃,试验就算成功。 表4汇总了由此产生的成功率。

blocks.en: Table 4: Experimental results of grasping and placement success rates for various industrial objects, categorized by dimensions, weight, and geometric complexity.
blocks.zh: 表4:按尺寸、重量和几何复杂程度分类的各种工业物体的把握和放置成功率的实验结果。
